findings.label: Control-character refusals labelled as ID numbers
findings.detail: serverError maps any server 'invalid' on name/district/mandal/note that passes check() to COPY.errors.idNumber. The server's _free_text_ok also refuses C0 control characters (e.g. a pasted tab), which the client does not check, so those refusals now show the Aadhaar sentence. Fix: mirror the control-character test in check(), or apply the ID-number mapping only to text containing a non-ASCII digit run.
